name: Jailbreak Building Limits
author: sorahn
description: Removes placement limits on Stratacores, Fluxite Generators, Void Seed Spawners, and other capped buildings.

uncapAll.descriptionKey: When enabled, removes placement limits for every structure in the game instead of only target structures.

uncapFluxiteGenerator.descriptionKey: Allow placing unlimited Fluxite Generators / Emanators.

uncapVoidSeedSpawner.descriptionKey: Allow placing unlimited Void Seed Spawners / Void Converters.

stabilizeCosts.descriptionKey: Prevents placement costs from scaling exponentially as more jailbroken structures are placed.
